name: baron-samedit
description: This repository contains a Proof-of-Concept (PoC) exploit for the Baron Samedit vulnerability (CVE-2021-3156). The exploit demonstrates privilege escalation on Ubuntu 20.04 with sudo version 1.8.31 and glibc version 2.31. It includes an assembly-based exploit, a shared object payload, and a Makefile for automated compilation.
